use_case_summary: Replace brittle keyword search with RAG-enabled semantic search over catalog embeddings + a learned reranker to boost conversion on long-tail queries. Primary KPIs: first-page CTR, add-to-cart rate, and cost per query during peak events.
requirements_summary: Index: ~45M SKUs (text+structured attrs). Query volume baseline 1M q/day with holiday peaks up to 8-10M q/day. Target p95 retrieval latency <120ms, end-to-end reranked response p95 <250ms. Cost target <$0.002 per query averaged over quarter. Security: VPC/private control plane for EU data, SOC2, KMS, audit logs, SSO. Support for gradual rollouts and A/B testing. SDKs + tracing hooks desired.
technical_constraints: Index size: embeddings for 45M records (~dense 768/1536 dim) => vector store sizing critical
Need prefix/KV caching for popular queries to reduce cost during spikes
Reranker model must be quantization-friendly or have cheaper CPU fallback
Prefer deterministic fallback routing by policy (latency vs cost)
